name: Very Real Pizza
summary: Step into the immersive world of Very Real Pizza, a cutting-edge Virtual Reality game that offers a dynamic and engaging way to hone essential job skills. Take on the role of a pizza shop manager and navigate through a fast-paced environment. From meticulously crafting pizzas following complex recipes and customer preferences, to handling orders during busy rushes, you'll learn to master multitasking and stress management.
